test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.

Anju told her brother that she was going to bake a cake for him that day.

options.text: Anju said to her brother, “I am going to bake a cake for him tomorrow.”
Anju said to her brother, “She is going to bake a cake for you today.”
Anju said to her brother, “I am going to bake a cake for you today.”
Anju said to her brother, “She was going to bake a cake for him today.”

solution:
The correct answer is **"Anju said to her brother, “I am going to bake a cake for you today.” "**
